QuestInfo.name: An Old Shoe
QuestInfo.0: You have found an interesting artifact.
QuestInfo.1: You have found an Old Shoe that belongs to a Maple Admin. How in the world does anyone lose a shoe?
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Admin says he lost his shoe when he was chasing after someone who was using an illegal macro program. He has given you a reward for returning his shoe to him.

0.0: Oh, this looks like a Maple Admin's shoe! I wonder how this got here.

no.0: Oh well, it's up to you.

1.0: Ah, thanks for bringing it. Blah blah blah.

npc.0: You haven't reported it to a Maple Admin yet.
